headline: Asian Paints: SEBI Takeover Regulation 31(4) Disclosure by Vakil Family Members
sum: Nehal, Bhairavi and Vivek Abhay Vakil submitted mandatory disclosure to NSE under SEBI Regulation 31(4) for substantial acquisition of shares in Asian Paints Limited, triggering takeover code compliance.
detail: The Vakil family members filed a mandated disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 with the NSE on 19 June 2026. This regulation requires parties acquiring shares of a listed company beyond specified thresholds to disclose the transaction and shareholding to the exchange and public. The disclosure was submitted as a compliance document and triggers standard takeover code review and potential open-offer requirements under SEBI rules.
